info.name: EgyTravel - Plan a Trip
info.description:
Manual trip planning APIs for EgyTravel.

Flow:

  1. Login → token auto-saved
  2. Create a trip (title, destination, dates, budget)
  3. Add days to the trip (day 1, day 2, ...)
  4. Fill each day with activities, locations, notes
  5. Attach hotel/flight bookings to the trip
  6. View the full trip with all days and bookings

Variables auto-saved by test scripts:

  • — from login
  • — from create trip
  • — from add day

request.description:
Create a new trip. tripId auto-saves to .

Required: title Optional: description, destination, startDate, endDate, budget
Get a single trip with all its days and linked bookings.

Update any trip field.

request.description:
Add a day to the trip. dayId auto-saves to .

Required: dayNumber Optional: date, title, description, activities (array), locations (array), budget, notes

Activities = list of strings Locations = list of { name, lat, lng }

request.description: Update any field of a day. Pass only the fields you want to change.

Save a hotel booking and link it to this trip via tripId.

The booking will appear in the trip's bookings list and in the day details when the check-in date matches.

Delete the entire trip and all its days.

⚠️ This does NOT delete linked bookings — they remain in your bookings list but lose the trip association.

Returns all locations from all days of the trip as map markers.

Flutter uses this to drop pins on the map showing everywhere the user plans to go.

Response includes:

  • markers[] — each with dayNumber, dayTitle, date, name, lat, lng
  • mapCenter — suggested camera center (average of all locations)
  • totalMarkers — total pin count

Requires auth token.
